title: SessionInstructionsSetPayload

text.description: A session's own instructions: Markdown, at most 20000 characters, which its runs are handed under # Instructions for this session, after the user, team-bank and project layers; empty when it has none.

description: session.instructions-set: the session's own instructions were set (sessions.setInstructions), empty text clearing them, or a fork was made with its source's. The session's next runs are handed them; a live run keeps what it began with.
